title: OVERRIDE: billing modal costflow attribution regressions found
summary: Audit of current code found the dashboard billing modal path can show wrong numbers: usage_reconcile_snapshot stores totals/sessions but not top-level cost even though sumUsageRecords expects snap.cost, so /costflow can emit by_model gross rows with server-priced $0.00; graph.html then recomputes dollars with a hard-coded client rate table that defaults non-Claude models to Sonnet-like prices instead of using adapter-priced cf.cost.by_model. The session catch-all path also subtracts claimed tokens only by transcript path, so snapshot session output can become a full catch-all even when task_key usage_records already claimed part of that session. This supersedes confidence from earlier gross/delta split fixes for the current billing modal implementation until repaired.
